text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Trainer-san over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was walking through the school in the 
evening, I was stopped by Seiun Sky. She 
said they're continuing the murder 
mystery.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So right away, continuing from where we 
left off—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Last time... it was revealed that the bowl 
of chawanmushi, the cause of death, 
changed from yellow to blue after being 
served, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And so, El, who visited the victim King's 
room after it was served, is suspicious...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Entering the room after dinner was 
served was just a coincidence, there's no 
proof I'm the culprit...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's quite fair. That being the case, 
shall we continue the investigation?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Phase II begins. Trainer-san, 
please read the script.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Seiun Sky, I cast my eyes on 
the script. And then—
choice_data_list:
"Everyone will now be able to reveal 
secrets."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Secrets...? Did we have something like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this thing written in the script. It 
says, "Secrets that can only be revealed 
in Phase II."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If new information comes to light, the 
suspect might change. ...What will 
everyone do?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's see... May I speak first, then?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Actually... After I served the meal, 
King-chan went back to the bath. It seems 
she forgot something there.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Eh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho? So King was gone from the room after 
the meal was served...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't you find that interesting? If 
King-chan left the room after it was 
served, there were no witnesses, so anyone 
could have snuck in.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In other words, anyone could have swapped 
the bowl— which means everyone is under 
suspicion.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! That means El isn't the only 
suspect anymore!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I will also reveal my special 
secret! Actually, when El went to see 
King—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The chawanmushi bowl was already blue! 
Which means the culprit entered the room 
before El did!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, the bowl was already...? That is very 
intriguing information.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
With more information, we can narrow down 
the culprit once again. Spe-chan, 
Sei-chan, won't you cooperate as well?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then I will, too... Actually, until we 
were gathered here, I was with Grass-chan 
after she finished serving dinner, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For just a split second, I caught a 
glimpse of Sei-chan walking while carrying 
something...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoops, me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, 'carrying something'? It couldn't 
have been... a yellow bowl, could it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, scary, scary. Now the suspicion is 
turned on me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This is tough... Hey, Trainer-san. Give me 
some backup.
choice_data_list: Wait, are you really just a cleaner...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice backup. Right, I'm a cleaner. Of 
course I'd be carrying various cleaning 
supplies.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Hearing you say that makes it sound 
even more suspicious. Because it's 
Sei-chan after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, that's mean. What do you take me 
for~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, even so... let's see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What would she say now that she was backed 
into a corner? As everyone braced 
themselves...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan's statement is true. Indeed, I 
was walking through the mansion carrying 
something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, she admitted it quite 
readily. Does she have some kind of 
plan...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what do you think? Maybe I'm not 
just a cleaner, but the world's strongest 
cleaner~. Nyahaha.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, isn't that totally not helping 
me? Jeez, get it together~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, even so... let's see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What would she say now that she was backed 
into a corner? As everyone braced 
themselves...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan's statement is true. Indeed, I 
was walking through the mansion carrying 
something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, she admitted it quite 
readily. Does she have some kind of 
plan...?
